name: datashard
description: Datashard, the company's knowledge base of verified facts, in Codex: the install's MCP server, the save skill, and $datashard-init to set up a project.

interface.shortDescription: The company's verified knowledge in Codex: search it, save to it, and set a project up.
interface.longDescription: Datashard connects Codex to the company's knowledge base of verified facts. The plugin brings $datashard-init, the save skill, an HTTP MCP server named datashard, and a hook that refuses a save whose install does not match the project's DATASHARD.md. Codex uses the address registered with codex mcp add for that server name.
defaultPrompt: Look up what the company has already decided about this before changing it.
